# GitHub Copilot instructions

The instructions for this repository live in **[AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md)**.

Read that file. It is the single source for the technology constraints, the code
conventions, the project structure and the environment variables.

This file used to hold its own copy. Keeping four near-identical instruction
files in sync failed in practice: they described the frontend as using Tailwind
CSS long after it had been removed, and pointed at `ModernApp.js` after it was
renamed to `.jsx`.
